videos.title: GPT-Image-2.6: Faster image generation with Flare and Sunburst
videos.description:
We’re bringing GPT-Image-2.6 to Codex and the API. In the API, the 2.6 versions of Flare and Sunburst generate images 50% faster than before.

Use Flare for a quick first pass on a poster or product shot. At low image quality, it can generate an image in as little as six seconds. When you need details to stay consistent across edits, use Sunburst at medium or high quality. Try changing a product’s backdrop while keeping its shape and texture, or bring a mascot to life as a looping GIF.

videos.title: H22 | Intro to COPs Concepts 10 | Mixing Layers
videos.description:
All Lessons and Project Files: https://www.sidefx.com/tutorials/intro-to-copernicus-concepts/

Learn how to combine and blend image layers in Houdini’s Copernicus using different compositing techniques. You’ll explore common blending modes, masking, image transitions, and the Layer Merge node to mix multiple layers within a procedural network.

You’ll also explore how to use cables and Sequence Blend to organize and transition between multiple image layers. These techniques give artists greater flexibility when creating procedural textures, combining visual elements, and managing complex image processing workflows in Copernicus.

videos.title: H22 | Intro to COPs Concepts 29 | Texture Baking
videos.description:
All Lessons and Project Files: https://www.sidefx.com/tutorials/intro-to-copernicus-concepts/

Learn how to bake high resolution geometry details onto a low resolution mesh using the texture baking tools in Houdini’s Copernicus. You’ll explore how to adjust the baking cage, control texture resolution, and generate useful maps such as normals, ambient occlusion, curvature, and height.

You’ll also explore how to preview the baked textures on the low resolution model and export the resulting maps for use in other applications. This workflow gives artists a practical way to preserve detailed surface information while keeping geometry optimized for rendering and real time production.

videos.title: H22 | Intro to COPs Concepts 22 | Height Maps
videos.description:
All Lessons and Project Files: https://www.sidefx.com/tutorials/intro-to-copernicus-concepts/

Learn how to create and manipulate height maps in Houdini’s Copernicus using procedural patterns and grayscale values. You’ll explore how to assign height information to image layers, adjust displacement, and introduce variations using randomized values.

You’ll also explore how to combine and remap height data to create more interesting surface patterns while maintaining control over the results. These techniques provide a practical foundation for creating procedural height fields and terrains in Copernicus.
